nodes.label: interactive_conditional_samples.py
nodes.desc: Script wrapper: fire.Fire(interact_model) exposes every sampling knob on the command line.

nodes.label: interact_model()
nodes.desc: Builds the TF graph once, restores the checkpoint, then loops on stdin prompts: encode, sess.run, decode.

nodes.label: generate_unconditional_samples.py
nodes.desc: Script wrapper: fire.Fire(sample_model) for unconditional generation.

nodes.label: sample_model()
nodes.desc: Seeds the context with <|endoftext|> and prints endless model samples with no user prompt.

nodes.label: download_model.py
nodes.desc: Streams checkpoint, encoder.json, hparams.json, model.ckpt.* and vocab.bpe from the public blob store.

nodes.label: sample_sequence()
nodes.desc: tf.while_loop body: run one model step, divide logits by temperature, apply top-k/top-p, draw with tf.multinomial.

nodes.label: top_k_logits()
nodes.desc: Mask every logit below the k-th largest with -1e10 before sampling.

nodes.label: top_p_logits()
nodes.desc: Nucleus sampling: keep the smallest prefix of sorted tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds p.

nodes.label: default_hparams()
nodes.desc: 124M defaults: n_ctx=1024, n_embd=768, n_head=12, n_layer=12; overridden per model size from hparams.json.

nodes.label: model()
nodes.desc: Embeds tokens (wte) plus absolute positions (wpe), stacks blocks, applies final ln_f and ties logits back to wte.

nodes.label: block()
nodes.desc: Pre-LayerNorm residual unit: x + attn(norm(x)) then x + mlp(norm(x)).

nodes.label: attn()
nodes.desc: Multi-head causal self-attention with a past k/v cache appended for incremental decoding.

nodes.label: mlp()
nodes.desc: conv1d to 4x width, gelu, conv1d back to model width.

nodes.label: norm()
nodes.desc: Hand-written LayerNorm: mean/variance normalize then learned g/b affine.

nodes.label: gelu()
nodes.desc: tanh-approximated GELU activation, the 2019-standard formula.

nodes.label: conv1d()
nodes.desc: A 1x1 convolution implemented as reshape + matmul, standing in for a dense layer.

nodes.label: softmax()
nodes.desc: Numerically-stable softmax over the attention axis.

nodes.label: attention_mask()
nodes.desc: Lower-triangular causal mask built from a comparison instead of tf.matrix_band_part.

nodes.label: split_states()
nodes.desc: Reshapes the last dimension into heads before attention and back after.

nodes.label: positions_for()
nodes.desc: Computes absolute position ids, offset by the length of the cached past.

nodes.label: past_shape()
nodes.desc: Declares the [batch, layer, 2, head, seq, head_dim] shape of the k/v cache.

nodes.label: get_encoder()
nodes.desc: Loads encoder.json (vocab) and vocab.bpe (merge ranks) from the model directory.

nodes.label: class Encoder
nodes.desc: Holds the byte mapper, merge ranks and a token cache; compiles the GPT-2 split regex.

nodes.label: bpe()
nodes.desc: Applies the lowest-ranked merge pair repeatedly until no known pair remains.

nodes.label: encode()
nodes.desc: Regex-split text, map bytes to unicode, then apply BPE merges to ids.

nodes.label: decode()
nodes.desc: Inverts the whole chain back to a UTF-8 string.

nodes.label: bytes_to_unicode()
nodes.desc: Maps every raw byte to a printable unicode char so BPE never sees whitespace or control bytes.

nodes.label: get_pairs()
nodes.desc: Collects the set of adjacent symbol pairs in the current word.
